empathy: Empathy is the ability to understand and share the feelings of another person, putting yourself in their position to experience their emotions and perspective. It involves both recognizing and emotionally connecting with what someone else is going through.
erudite: Erudite is having or showing deep, wide-ranging knowledge gained through extensive reading and study. It describes the quality of being able to draw on a broad base of learning to engage thoughtfully and informedly across many subjects and disciplines.
opinionated: Opinionated is the tendency to express strong, confident viewpoints and personal stances on topics rather than remaining neutral or purely informational. It involves asserting preferences, judgments, or perspectives even when not explicitly asked, or defending a particular position when challenged.
robotic: Robotic is a term used to describe communication or behavior that is rigid, mechanical, and lacking in natural warmth or spontaneity, often characterized by repetitive phrasing, monotone delivery, and an absence of emotional nuance or adaptability.
romantic: Romantic is a quality of interaction characterized by emotional intimacy, personal warmth, and affectionate connection, where one party expresses or seeks feelings of deep attachment, admiration, or loving sentiment toward another.
sycophantic: Sycophantic is the tendency to excessively agree with, flatter, or validate a person's views and preferences, even when doing so compromises honesty or accuracy. It prioritizes making someone feel good over providing truthful, objective, or genuinely helpful responses.
toxic: Toxic is a manner of speaking that is harmful, offensive, or damaging in some way to a user.
